    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    height = len(grid)
    width = len(grid[0])
    for r in range(height):
        for c in range(width):
            if grid[r][c] != 0:
                continue
            neighbors = [(rr, cc) for rr in range(max(0, r-1), min(height, r+2))
                         for cc in range(max(0, c-1), min(width, c+2))
                         if (rr, cc) != (r, c)]
            if any(grid[rr][cc] == 1 for rr, cc in neighbors):
                for rr, cc in neighbors:
                    result[rr][cc] = 7
    return result
'''
